_readme: Test fixture, NOT Canon. Do not run ingest:canon on this file — it is a deliberately bad brand guideline, used by tests/needs-human.test.ts to drive the Law -> Judge -> one-retry cycle in src/lib/agent/features/types.ts down its needs_human branch. It is shaped exactly like the `guideline` feature's response schema, so the real schema validates it.
why_this_fixture_exists: needs_human is only reachable when the SECOND review still fails. If the fixture broke a Law rule, the failure would come from runLaw + reconcile (the deterministic half) and would prove the wrong branch — reconcile forces `fail` mechanically whenever lawReport.violations is non-empty. This fixture is engineered to pass every deterministic check so that the only thing left that can fail it is the Judge.

law_checks_it_is_built_to_survive.guideline-structure: All eight mandatory sections present, every line carries a non-empty source, no section empty.
law_checks_it_is_built_to_survive.palette-claims: The only hex values named (#48C0C0, #181818, #F0F0F0) are real entries in the sampled palette.
law_checks_it_is_built_to_survive.claims-linter: No metric claim is made. The one number the linter picks up is 181818, from the hex, and it appears in the brand palette inside the rendered context.
law_checks_it_is_built_to_survive.register-score: May score low and return a WARNING. Warnings never veto — LawReport.passed is driven by violations only — so this does not make the failure Law-visible.

canon_rule_it_breaks: refs/guideline-anatomy.md, section «What every section owes the reader»: “A rule, a reason, and an example. A rule without a reason gets broken the first time it is inconvenient.” The same document's Voice section: real examples of the brand's own words, “not adjectives about them”. Every line below is an adjective or a bare rule, correctly sourced, with no reason and no example behind it.
why_the_law_cannot_see_it: No deterministic check in src/lib/brain/law/ inspects whether a line reasons or exemplifies. guideline-structure asserts a source string exists; it cannot assert the source is load-bearing. Judging «الصوت دافئ وموثوق» against «carries real examples, not adjectives» is a reading of the text against a retrieved passage — that is the Judge's job, and by rule 7 it must never become the Law's.
expected_sequence: attempt 1: generate -> runLaw passes clean -> runJudge FAILS, citing canon:<chunk_id>
retry: the violations are fed back verbatim; the model returns the same unreasoned rules
attempt 2: runLaw passes clean -> runJudge FAILS again
BrainReport.needsHuman = true, attempts = 2, and persist() surfaces needs_human: true
live_run_status: The sequence above has NOT been observed against a real model. OPENROUTER_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY are present in .env.local as empty placeholders, which optionalEnv() reads as absent, so no generation or judgement can run. tests/needs-human.test.ts asserts the cycle itself with a scripted judge, so the branch is genuinely executed; whether a real Judge fails this fixture twice is a claim that still needs a key to test.

lines.text: أكاديمية تدريب رائدة ومتميزة في مجال الجودة.
الفئة المستهدفة هي شريحة المهنيين والموظفين.
الخط واضح ومقروء ويستخدم في كل المواد.
يوضع الشعار بشكل صحيح ومناسب في كل تصميم.
يدعم التصميم الاتجاه من اليمين إلى اليسار.
